backlog.spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**18 (~262K tokens per step). With only 300 s of training, more optimizer steps usually help. Keep DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64 so grad accumulation drops to 2 per step at 2**18 (or whatever the existing formula yields). No other changes.

backlog.spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**17 (~131K tokens). This gives many more steps in the fixed time. Keep the LRs unchanged and make sure the grad accumulation computation still divides evenly (DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE*seq_len=64*2048=2**17, so it becomes 1 step).
backlog.title: Lower total batch to 2**17

backlog.spec: Set DEPTH = 6 (model_dim = 384 with ASPECT_RATIO 64). A smaller model gets more tokens in 300 s. Leave everything else unchanged. Check that the model dim is a multiple of HEAD_DIM, and adjust ASPECT_RATIO to 85 (dim 512) if needed.
backlog.title: Depth 6 wider-per-time tradeoff

backlog.spec: Set DEPTH = 10 and TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**18 to test whether a larger model pays off. The dim becomes 640, which is a multiple of 128. If it OOMs, reduce DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE to 32.
backlog.title: Depth 10 with smaller batch

backlog.spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.7 so the LR decays linearly over the last 70% of the time budget.
backlog.title: Warmdown ratio 0.7

backlog.spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.3 to spend more time at peak LR.

backlog.spec: Set FINAL_LR_FRAC = 0.05 so the LR never reaches exactly zero at the end of warmdown.
backlog.title: Final LR fraction 0.05

backlog.spec: Set WARMUP_RATIO = 0.02 to ramp the LR up over the first 2% of the time budget, which stabilizes the initial high-LR Muon and Adam steps.
backlog.title: Short warmup

backlog.spec: Set MATRIX_LR = 0.05 for the Muon matrices.
backlog.title: Matrix LR 0.05

backlog.spec: Set EMBEDDING_LR = 0.8 for the token embedding Adam group.
backlog.title: Embedding LR 0.8

backlog.spec: Double UNEMBEDDING_LR to 0.008 so the lm_head learns faster in the short run.
backlog.title: Unembedding LR 0.008

backlog.spec: Set SCALAR_LR = 0.25 to reduce the instability of the per-layer scalars.
backlog.title: Scalar LR 0.25

backlog.spec: Set WEIGHT_DECAY = 0.1. Short training may need less regularization.
backlog.title: Weight decay 0.1

backlog.spec: Make the Muon weight decay follow the LR multiplier. Keep WEIGHT_DECAY = 0.2 as the base and multiply it by the current lr schedule factor each step, so decay goes to 0 at the end of warmdown.
backlog.title: Weight decay linearly decayed

backlog.spec: Change ADAM_BETAS to (0.9, 0.95).
backlog.title: Adam beta1 0.9

backlog.spec: Change ADAM_BETAS to (0.8, 0.99) for smoother second-moment estimates.
backlog.title: Adam beta2 0.99

backlog.spec: Change WINDOW_PATTERN to "SSSSSSSL" (with DEPTH 8) so most layers use half-context windows. This saves compute and gives more steps. The last layer is always full.
backlog.title: Window pattern all-short plus final long

backlog.spec: Set WINDOW_PATTERN = "L" so every layer uses full context, to check whether the sliding window hurts.
backlog.title: Window pattern all long

backlog.spec: Set HEAD_DIM = 64, giving more attention heads (8 at dim 512). Confirm that the n_kv_head setup follows n_head.
backlog.title: Head dim 64

backlog.spec: Set ASPECT_RATIO = 80 so model_dim = 640 (a multiple of 128). Wider model with the same depth. If it OOMs, reduce DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE to 32 and keep the total batch the same.
backlog.title: Aspect ratio 80 at depth 8

backlog.spec: If the model uses logit softcapping (e.g. 15 or 30 via tanh), set the cap to 15. If it does not, add logits = 15*tanh(logits/15) before the loss, computed in float32.
backlog.title: Logit softcap 15

backlog.spec: Reduce the MLP hidden size from 4x to 3x dim to cut compute per step and raise the step count in 300 s. Adjust the c_fc and c_proj sizes together.
backlog.title: ReLU squared to SwiGLU-free tweak: smaller MLP expansion

backlog.spec: Change the Muon momentum schedule so that it ramps from 0.85 to 0.95 over the first 100 steps instead of the current ramp length, and holds at 0.95. If the existing ramp is already like this, hold at 0.97 during the warmdown phase.
backlog.title: Muon momentum warmup shorter

backlog.spec: Reduce the Muon polar-express/Newton-Schulz iterations from 5 to 4 to cut optimizer overhead slightly, if the code exposes the ns_steps count.
backlog.title: Muon Newton-Schulz 4 steps

backlog.spec: Initialize the attention c_proj and MLP c_proj weights to zero if they are not already, so each block starts as the identity.
backlog.title: Zero-init residual projections

backlog.spec: If the model has value embeddings with gated mixing, lower the gate init so the value-embedding contribution starts at half strength. Otherwise skip this and set the x0 residual-lambda init to 0.1.
backlog.title: Untied value-embedding scale init

backlog.spec: Make sure the cross-entropy is computed on bf16 logits upcast chunk-wise only if memory is a problem. Otherwise leave it. Combined with this, set DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE = 32 to test whether the smaller micro-batch speeds up throughput, keeping TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE the same.
backlog.title: Disable torch.compile dynamic overhead via bf16 fused CE

backlog.spec: Add torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0) after the accumulated backward and before the optimizer step, to reduce spikes at high LR.
backlog.title: Gradient clipping 1.0

backlog.spec: Replace WARMUP_RATIO and WARMDOWN_RATIO with a linear decay schedule using a normalized learning rate (0 -> max_lr -> 0) to smooth optimization dynamics and potentially allow higher final effective learning rates without instability.
backlog.title: Linear Learning Rate Schedule with Normalizer

backlog.spec: Introduce a normalization strategy that normalizes the Adam buffer with a 1/coefficient for efficiency and improved performance.
backlog.title: Debiasing Normalize on Prefered Hyperbolic Space

backlog.spec: Replace the standard warmup and warmsdown schedule with a cosine annealing schedule that cycles through a range of learning rates, potentially improving generalization.
backlog.title: Use Cosine Annealing with Restart on 1-cyclical learning rate schedule

backlog.spec: Replace the current warmup/warmdown schedule with a cosine annealing schedule with restarts to improve training stability and generalization.
backlog.title: CosineAnnealingLR Scheduler with Restart on 1-cyclical

backlog.spec: Try using Muon optimizer with default hyperparameters to see if it performs better than the current configuration.
backlog.title: Replace AdamW with Muon with Default Hyperparameters

backlog.spec: Add layer-wise weight normalization to improve training stability and convergence speed.
backlog.title: Introduce Layer-wise Weight Normalization

backlog.spec: Replace the current AdamW optimizer with an AdamW optimizer that includes gradient clipping and normalization to improve training stability and convergence speed.
backlog.title: Use AdamW optimizer with Gradient Normalization

backlog.spec: Modify the attention kernel to use a 'Mix' window pattern that dynamically switches between sliding and global attention within each step based on a hidden state threshold, increasing effective context for important tokens while maintaining efficiency for others. This should be implemented as a conditional logic block replacing the standard SlidingWindow construction in the transformer block.
backlog.title: Mix-Former Adaptive Windowing

backlog.spec: Replace the current AdamW usage with an implementation that computes debiased gradients (accounting for batch effects in second moments) and applies momentum normalization (renormalizing the first and second moment tensors to unit norm before the update step) to stabilize training on the fixed 300s budget.
backlog.title: Debiased AdamW with Gradient Renormalization

backlog.spec: Replace the current warmup/warmdown scheme with a Cosine Annealing schedule that restarts every 2 cycles (2 * total_steps * 0.05), maintaining a high learning rate for longer to allow the model to overcome initial minima before fine-tuning through smaller steps in the final 10%. Implement this by changing the get_lr() call to use a custom CosineWithRestartsScheduler.
backlog.title: Cosine Restart Annealing with 2-Cycles

backlog.spec: Introduce a Hybrid LayerNorm module where the first 2/3 of the statistical normalization (reduction and scaling) is done with local statistics per layer, while the final 1/3 uses global batch-wide statistics (tied to a shared MLP head). This requires adding a GlobalNorm component and a fusion window in the layer norm module.
backlog.title: H-ybrid LayerNorm with Global Stat Binding

backlog.spec: Add a scaling factor to the pre-activation inputs of the first few layers (input projections) that scales from 0.1 to 1.0 over the first 30% of training steps, and then remains at 1.0. This creates a soft curriculum that initializes the model weights more stably. Implement as a simple lookup table or sine-based ramp applied before the linear projections.
backlog.title: Curriculum Pre-activation Scaling

backlog.spec: Implement an adaptive weight decay mechanism where the weight decay is 0.0 for skips and FFN (residuals in MHA), but 0.01 for the attention projections and MLP expansions. This uses a custom gradient clipping step that applies different decay rates based on layer type to reduce overflow risk while stabilizing attention maps.
backlog.title: Adaptive Weight Decay Masking

backlog.spec: At each batch step, identify the top-K (e.g., K=4) highest norm gradients across the batch and apply a smoothing penalty to the low-norm gradients before clipping. This 'gradient routing' prevents small, noisy gradients from going unnormalized and being amplified by large delta weights. Implement via a mask matrix and top-k sort logic in the optimization loop.
backlog.title: Gradient Routing with Top-K Masking

backlog.spec: Modify the final linear layer to apply a temperature-softmax warp function that dynamically changes the temperature from 10 to 1.0 over the first 40% of training, then stays at 1.0. This acts as a soft logit softcap that progressively sharpens predictions without altering weights, implemented as a post-linear, pre-softmax temperature scaling factor.
backlog.title: Logit Temperature Warping

backlog.spec: Configure the optimizer to use different beta2 values per layer: 0.99 for attention layers (to accelerate convergence) and 0.85 for MLP layers (to smooth updates), based on the empirical observation that MLPs need slower adaptation. Implement a per-layer L1 lookup table in the AdamW state file.
backlog.title: Layer-wise AdamBETA

backlog.spec: Add a significant residual stream to the attention output by fusing the attention weights with the identity tensor before the addition step, increasing the 'identity' component of the output by 1.3x. This encourages the model to rely more heavily on the original sentence structure and reduces overfitting, implemented in the standard self-attention block.
backlog.title: Attention Residual Injection

memo:
Helped: two accepted changes that make each step cheaper under the fixed 300 s budget. DEPTH 8 to 6 gave 1.0828/1.0866 (-0.0298), and total batch 2**17 gave 1.0610/1.0623 (-0.0231). Both carry a tripwire flag, so check it before building on them. Incumbent mean is 1.0617 over 2 runs.

Did not help: larger or wider models (ASPECT_RATIO 80 at 1.1010, DEPTH 10 at 1.1456), HEAD_DIM 64 (+0.0030), MLP 3x (+0.0046), WARMUP_RATIO 0.02, shorter warmdown (+0.0031). Small gains such as SCALAR_LR 0.25 (-0.0012), gradient clipping (-0.0006), and removing LR scaling (-0.0005) were rejected as likely noise. Three runs crashed or aborted: two from AdamW with bogus imports, one a repeated zero-init.

Next: smaller models (DEPTH 5, lower ASPECT_RATIO) and a smaller batch (2**16). Replicate any gain under 0.005. Avoid optimizer rewrites.
